decisions.reason: The all-caps decision necessarily determines the case of the internal letterforms being constructed for the initial complete wordmark.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Kenji,

Before work begins, I want to clarify the direction for the first complete VEILLVÉ wordmark: please continue initially with the all-caps treatment. My instinct is that all caps is the right first direction because of the architectural rhythm it creates, particularly with the hero V leading the word.

Another case treatment can certainly be explored if, after we have reviewed the complete wordmark, a compelling reason appears. Until then, it is important to see the architectural vision we have spent months developing come together as one complete identity.

That treatment emerged naturally during the process while the hero V was being developed; I realized, however, that I had never made a conscious decision about it. We have now established the architectural language, and applying it to the complete wordmark is exactly where I hoped we would go next. I am excited to see the system functioning as a whole.

I am really looking forward to the first VEILLVÉ wordmark.

value_updates.case_treatment: Construct the internal letterforms in all caps for the initial complete VEILLVÉ wordmark; explore another case only if later review provides a compelling reason.

decisions.reason: The approved Hero V is already a capital form, and the source changes the complete wordmark's case treatment without changing its locked geometry.
The all-caps composition decision is consistent with the existing architectural brand expression but does not modify any of its current attributes.
The source addresses letter case and composition, not the deferred champagne-gold material treatment or its application sequence.
Using an all-caps wordmark does not change the established rule that the É accent must duplicate the approved Hero V terminal geometry.

The second V is part of the complete VEILLVÉ spelling, so the all-caps decision necessarily establishes an uppercase supporting V for the initial wordmark while leaving other case exploration possible later.
